kLim.zh: 当 xxx 越来越靠近 aaa 时，f(x)f(x)f(x) 越来越靠近哪个数。
kLim.en: The value f(x)f(x)f(x) gets arbitrarily close to as xxx gets close to aaa.

kChain.zh: 复合函数的导数等于各层导数相乘：(f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x)) g′(x)(f\circ g)'(x)=f'(g(x))\,g'(x)(f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x))g′(x)。
kChain.en: The derivative of a composition is the product of the layers’ derivatives: (f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x)) g′(x)(f\circ g)'(x)=f'(g(x))\,g'(x)(f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x))g′(x).

kGrad.zh: 多个输入时，对每个输入分别求导（其余不动），排成一个向量 ∇f\nabla f∇f。
kGrad.en: With several inputs, differentiate with respect to each one (holding the rest fixed) and stack the results into a vector ∇f\nabla f∇f.

kVec.zh: 一串数就是一个向量；两个向量的点积 a⋅b=∑iaibia\cdot b=\sum_i a_i b_ia⋅b=∑i​ai​bi​ 衡量它们有多“同向”。
kVec.en: A list of numbers is a vector; the dot product a⋅b=∑iaibia\cdot b=\sum_i a_i b_ia⋅b=∑i​ai​bi​ measures how much two vectors point the same way.

kMat.zh: (AB)ij=∑kAikBkj(AB)_{ij}=\sum_k A_{ik}B_{kj}(AB)ij​=∑k​Aik​Bkj​：第 i 行和第 j 列做点积。
kMat.en: (AB)ij=∑kAikBkj(AB)_{ij}=\sum_k A_{ik}B_{kj}(AB)ij​=∑k​Aik​Bkj​: the dot product of row i with column j.

kDet.zh: 2×2 矩阵把单位正方形变成平行四边形，面积乘上 ∣det⁡A∣=∣ad−bc∣|\det A|=|ad-bc|∣detA∣=∣ad−bc∣。
kDet.en: A 2×2 matrix turns the unit square into a parallelogram whose area is multiplied by ∣det⁡A∣=∣ad−bc∣|\det A|=|ad-bc|∣detA∣=∣ad−bc∣.

kJac.zh: 向量函数的所有偏导排成的矩阵 Jij=∂yi/∂xjJ_{ij}=\partial y_i/\partial x_jJij​=∂yi​/∂xj​；梯度往回传时要乘它的转置。
kJac.en: The matrix of all partial derivatives of a vector function, Jij=∂yi/∂xjJ_{ij}=\partial y_i/\partial x_jJij​=∂yi​/∂xj​; gradients flow back through its transpose.

kProb.zh: 每种结果一个概率，全部加起来等于 1；期望 E[X]=∑xx p(x)\mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_x x\,p(x)E[X]=∑x​xp(x) 是按概率加权的平均。
kProb.en: One probability per outcome, summing to 1; the expectation E[X]=∑xx p(x)\mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_x x\,p(x)E[X]=∑x​xp(x) is the probability-weighted average.

kBayes.zh: P(A∣B)=P(B∣A) P(A)P(B)P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B)}P(A∣B)=P(B)P(B∣A)P(A)​：看到证据 B 之后，A 的可能性怎样更新。
kBayes.en: P(A∣B)=P(B∣A) P(A)P(B)P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)\,P(A)}{P(B)}P(A∣B)=P(B)P(B∣A)P(A)​: how the probability of A updates after seeing evidence B.

kSoft.zh: 把任意一组分数 zzz 变成概率：pi=ezi/∑jezjp_i=e^{z_i}/\sum_j e^{z_j}pi​=ezi​/∑j​ezj​。
kSoft.en: Turns any scores zzz into probabilities: pi=ezi/∑jezjp_i=e^{z_i}/\sum_j e^{z_j}pi​=ezi​/∑j​ezj​.

kEnt.zh: 熵 H(p)=−∑plog⁡pH(p)=-\sum p\log pH(p)=−∑plogp 衡量不确定性；交叉熵 H(p,q)=−∑plog⁡qH(p,q)=-\sum p\log qH(p,q)=−∑plogq 衡量“用 q 去猜 p”有多差。
kEnt.en: Entropy H(p)=−∑plog⁡pH(p)=-\sum p\log pH(p)=−∑plogp measures uncertainty; cross-entropy H(p,q)=−∑plog⁡qH(p,q)=-\sum p\log qH(p,q)=−∑plogq measures how badly q predicts p.

kKL.zh: KL(p∥q)=∑plog⁡pq\mathrm{KL}(p\Vert q)=\sum p\log\frac{p}{q}KL(p∥q)=∑plogqp​：两个分布差多远，永远 ≥ 0，相等时为 0。
kKL.en: KL(p∥q)=∑plog⁡pq\mathrm{KL}(p\Vert q)=\sum p\log\frac{p}{q}KL(p∥q)=∑plogqp​: how far apart two distributions are; always ≥ 0, and 0 only when they are equal.

kGD.zh: 反复执行 θ←θ−η ∇L(θ)\theta\leftarrow\theta-\eta\,\nabla L(\theta)θ←θ−η∇L(θ)，一步步让损失变小。
kGD.en: Repeat θ←θ−η ∇L(θ)\theta\leftarrow\theta-\eta\,\nabla L(\theta)θ←θ−η∇L(θ) to lower the loss step by step.

kLR.zh: 步长 η\etaη 太小走得慢，太大会来回震荡甚至发散。
kLR.en: With too small a step η\etaη progress is slow; too large and it oscillates or diverges.

kSCE.zh: 对分数 zzz 的梯度就是“预测概率 − 正确答案”：∇zL=p−y\nabla_z L=p-y∇z​L=p−y。
kSCE.en: The gradient with respect to the scores zzz is “predicted probabilities − correct answer”: ∇zL=p−y\nabla_z L=p-y∇z​L=p−y.

kSqrt.zh: 打分除以 dk\sqrt{d_k}dk​​，让点积的方差回到 1，softmax 不至于饱和。
kSqrt.en: Dividing the scores by dk\sqrt{d_k}dk​​ brings the dot product’s variance back to 1, so softmax does not saturate.

kRes.zh: y=x+F(x)y=x+F(x)y=x+F(x) 的雅可比是 I+∂F/∂xI+\partial F/\partial xI+∂F/∂x，梯度总有一条“直通”的路。
kRes.en: The Jacobian of y=x+F(x)y=x+F(x)y=x+F(x) is I+∂F/∂xI+\partial F/\partial xI+∂F/∂x, so the gradient always has a straight-through path.

kPG.zh: ∇θJ=E[R ∇θlog⁡πθ(τ)]\nabla_\theta J=\mathbb{E}\big[R\,\nabla_\theta\log\pi_\theta(\tau)\big]∇θ​J=E[R∇θ​logπθ​(τ)]：奖励高的输出，提高它的概率。
kPG.en: ∇θJ=E[R ∇θlog⁡πθ(τ)]\nabla_\theta J=\mathbb{E}\big[R\,\nabla_\theta\log\pi_\theta(\tau)\big]∇θ​J=E[R∇θ​logπθ​(τ)]: raise the probability of outputs that earned high reward.
